kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نغترب (form VIII)
# نَغْتَرِبُ (naḡtaribu) /naɣ.ta.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# نُغْتَرَبُ (nuḡtarabu) /nuɣ.ta.ra.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# نَغْتَرِبَ (naḡtariba) /naɣ.ta.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# نُغْتَرَبَ (nuḡtaraba) /nuɣ.ta.ra.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
